e22_esb_identity_hash_convention: e22_esb_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('earnings22-original', sample_ids)) over earnings22-original/<call>-<segment>, the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time and the value an exposure row must carry.
e22_esb_media_root_unchanged: The drawn items keep the sealed dev-v1 media_relpath and audio_sha256 EXACTLY -- nothing is re-cut and no new derived root exists. That is what makes a cell on this subset paired row for row against the sealed SAEA-E22-DEV-ESB-PROMPT-A-V1 outputs (attempt-20260905T073641Z-f977d1) on identical audio bytes. The 1,500 WAVs live under $SPEECHRL_DATA_DIR/derived/e22-esb-utterances/dev-v1/ beside the other 4,538 and never enter Git.
e22_esb_d1_media_supplement: The 1,500 utterance ids enter D1's identity closure through the additive media supplement named above (schema saea-d1-media-supplement-v1, the shape contracts.gate_media_identity reads); it chains to the 6,038-row dev10 supplement through parent_d1_sha256 and to this population's own probe view through source_binding_sha256 fe9528be.
e22_esb_split_role_basis: No owner allowance is involved and none is claimed. These ten calls ARE this study's registered earnings22-original dev subset10 (docs/receipts/splits.json, split 'dev', count 10, identity 89b178d6b1ef46d9ca820ae54349e3d2099c60cde6d6b753ef9f66137c310028), which is the split this study may optimize on. No confirmatory call is named, loaded, decoded, scored or read by this fragment or by any run that composes it, and the six calibration-exposed ESB test calls stay a separate population with a separate roster, a separate reference layer and a separate derived media root.
e22_esb_reference_boundary: The 'sentence' column is gold and NEVER enters the request path. The roster receipt this fragment names carries identifiers, media paths, measured media identity and segment spans only. References live in the hash-pinned dev10 derived layer that only reproduction.esb_reference (scoring side) resolves -- the SAME layer the sealed dev arms were scored against, unedited, because these 1,500 ids are a subset of those 6,038.
e22_esb_clamped_to_decoded_parent: None. The one dev10 utterance whose end_ts was clamped to its decoded parent, 4481952-631, was NOT drawn into this subset; the roster receipt records clamped_to_decoded_parent as the empty list.
e22_esb_window_fit: The longest utterance is 32.880000 s -> 13 * ceil(32.88) = 429 speech tokens, far inside the -c 40960 -np 8 geometry's 5,120-token slot that the full dev10's 78.36 s utterance forced. Worst required = 429 speech + the 49-token arm A text envelope + 1024 completion + 2 special = about 1504, a ratio of 3.4x on this repository's own slot_tokens >= 2 x worst rule.
